question: The average of first 169 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The direct formula for the average of the first n even numbers is (n + 1).

Here, the total number of terms, n = 169.

⇒ Average = 169 + 1

⇒ Average = 170

**∴ The correct answer is 170.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of terms (n) = 169

The sequence consists of the first 169 positive even numbers.
